LESSON: TIME (DAILY ROUTINES)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: MEASUREMENT
Topic 3.4: Time (Daily routines)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time (Daily routines), part of MEASUREMENT in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: howing various daily routine activities in order. 1. Why do we identify daily routine activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time (Daily routines) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner talks to and works with each other in groups as they arrange pictures of various

daily activities.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner cooperates with one another in groups while arranging pictures of different daily activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety: The learner observes home arrival times (not to walk late in the evening alone)

Link to other activity areas:

• Language Activities: The learner tells various daily activities relating them to the vocabulary morning, noon and evening.

Suggested Resources:

Pictures and picture cut outs showing children doing different activities at different times of the day (morning, noon & evening)
